content.value_statement: X creators need current source material before writing posts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through four search rounds and a structured research report.
actual_capabilities: Runs a four-round research workflow for a user-provided topic.
Prioritizes official sources, GitHub, announcements, and documentation.
Collects technical explanations, tutorials, comparisons, reviews, and pros or cons.
Identifies information gaps after earlier search rounds.
Produces a structured material report with source URLs and post angles.
Suggests passing collected material to x-filter for scoring.
limitations: Requires web search access and an internet connection.
Produces research material, not finished social posts.
Defaults to Chinese output unless the user requests another language.
Search quality depends on available public sources.

use_cases.title: Research X Threads
use_cases.description: Gather official sources, reviews, comparisons, and gaps before drafting an X thread.

use_cases.title: Track Technology Launches
use_cases.description: Collect recent announcements, docs, and technical explanations for a new product or protocol.

use_cases.title: Prepare Editorial Briefs
use_cases.description: Create a source-backed brief with trend signals, controversy, and possible content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Collection
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect materials for {topic} in Chinese using the default four-round workflow.

prompt_templates.title: English Source Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research {topic} for X posts in English. Prioritize official docs, GitHub, reviews, and recent updates. Include source URLs and post angles.

prompt_templates.title: Competitive Angle Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect material for {topic} compared with {competitor}. Separate official claims, independent reviews, controversy, adoption signals, and unanswered questions.

prompt_templates.title: Gap-Driven Research Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a four-round collection for {topic}. After each round, identify gaps, refine searches, and deliver heat, trend, controversy, and next-step recommendations.

output_examples.input: Research Claude MCP protocol for X posts.
output: A topic report with official definition, key features, and recent updates.
A material list with source URLs, summaries, key points, and possible post angles.
A brief trend and controversy section for deciding what to write next.

output_examples.input: Collect latest AI agent material in English.
output: A source-backed research brief organized by official sources, technical analysis, reviews, and gaps.
Suggested tweet types such as technical explanation, trend comment, or product comparison.

best_practices: Provide a narrow topic and the preferred output language.
Ask for source URLs when the material will support public posts.
Review the collected sources before drafting claims for publication.
anti_patterns: Do not use broad topics that produce shallow search results.
Do not treat collected material as fact without source review.
Do not ask it to generate final posts before research is complete.

faq.question: Does this skill write X posts?
faq.answer: It collects material for posts. Use another writing step to draft final content.

faq.question: What language does it use?
faq.answer: It defaults to Chinese. You can request English or another language.

faq.question: Does it need web access?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow depends on web search and current public sources.

faq.question: What sources does it prefer?
faq.answer: It starts with official docs, GitHub, and announcements, then adds analysis and reviews.

faq.question: Can it compare competing tools?
faq.answer: Yes. Include the competitor name and ask for comparison-focused searches.

faq.question: How does it support follow-up filtering?
faq.answer: It suggests sending collected material to x-filter for scoring and selection.
